entries.group: Black Guard – High Lord Cassian Thorne
entries.question: Keep the name High Lord Cassian Thorne?

entries.group: Black Guard – High Lord Cassian Thorne
entries.question: How old is he, and how long has he led the Black Guard?
entries.custom_text: He has always been in the military. He had his daughter at 30. His daughter is now 20. He started the black guard from scratch and the main character is under the first black guard division ever created.

entries.group: Black Guard – High Lord Cassian Thorne
entries.question: Which sin tempts him most (the bible says he is secretly very Proud)?
entries.custom_text: He looks humble and intelligent and smart and ambitious and humorous and just and caring and thinks what is best for the empire. Internally he is seeking the power that will save humanity and doesn’t believe the empire is doing it right. He was secretly born in a rival kingdom

entries.group: Black Guard – High Lord Cassian Thorne
entries.question: How did he get the title?
entries.answer: Appointed by the Council for his brilliance

entries.group: Black Guard – High Lord Cassian Thorne
entries.question: His view of the census of the corrupted?
entries.answer: Against it — he wants to use corruption, not count it

entries.group: Black Guard – High Lord Cassian Thorne
entries.question: His role toward Alaric and Seraphina?
entries.custom_text: He mentors and truly sees Alaric as the future, but he will have to slowly change Alaric’s views to better the world. Truly loves his daughter but humanity comes first

entries.group: Black Guard – High Lord Cassian Thorne
entries.question: Does Seraphina know Cassian was secretly born in a rival kingdom?
entries.answer: No, Seraphina doesn't know. She finds out during the story.

entries.group: Black Guard – High Lord Cassian Thorne
entries.question: Who was Seraphina's mother?
entries.answer: A noblewoman from the Capital Kingdom.
